assessment.assessmentNote: Clear lecture notes on the 4Ps and the extended services mix.

questions.prompt: According to the notes, which element of the marketing mix is the only one that produces revenue?
questions.explanation: The notes state that price is the only element of the mix that produces revenue, while the other elements represent costs.
questions.sourceQuote: It is the only element of the mix that produces revenue; the other elements represent costs.

questions.prompt: In the notes' power bank example, what is the customer really buying?
options: Uninterrupted phone use during a power outage
A discount on a future purchase
questions.explanation: The example illustrates that customers buy the benefits a product delivers, here uninterrupted phone use during an outage.
questions.sourceQuote: a buyer of a power bank is really buying uninterrupted phone use during a power outage

questions.prompt: Which pricing method do the notes recommend for luxury fashion brands?
questions.sourceQuote: Luxury brands should always use price skimming to signal exclusivity.

questions.prompt: How do the notes describe a short distribution channel?
options: It passes through wholesalers and retailers
It moves goods directly from producer to consumer
It relies only on online advertising
It stores inventory in several regional warehouses
questions.explanation: A short channel moves goods directly from producer to consumer, while a long channel passes through wholesalers and retailers.
questions.sourceQuote: A short channel moves goods directly from producer to consumer

questions.prompt: Which three elements does the services marketing mix add to the 4Ps?
questions.explanation: Because services are intangible and perishable, the extended mix adds people, process and physical evidence, giving 7Ps.
questions.sourceQuote: the services marketing mix adds three further elements: people, process and physical evidence

questions.prompt: According to the notes, what happens when one element of the mix contradicts the others?
options: Customers receive a confused message and positioning fails
Distribution automatically switches to a long channel
questions.explanation: The notes stress that the elements must support one another; contradictions confuse customers and the positioning strategy fails.
questions.sourceQuote: customers receive a confused message and the positioning strategy fails
